items.name: Hiromasa OPTI V7 Free
items.description: Performance-oriented client graphics pack with revised weather, water and lighting.
items.author: Hiromasa
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy.
Use the free V7 package listed by Hiromasa. Extract the archive and follow the creator’s FiveM plugins-folder guide.
items.previewCaption: Still from Hiromasa’s OPTI V7 showcase.

items.name: Glint 1.0 + GlintVisuals
items.description: A ReShade add-on and companion visual pack for lighting, reflections, volumetric weather and updated textures.
items.author: Glint
items.credits: Glint. Timecycles and weather by Dee.
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy with DirectX 11 and ReShade.
Choose the GlintVisuals.rpf FiveM build. The release author notes a substantial GPU cost.
items.previewCaption: Original in-game screenshot from the Glint release.

items.name: Realistic Coast RolePlay Preset
items.description: A coastal color grade with cooler blues, stronger contrast and film grain.
items.author: PrimeGraphics
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy and ReShade with the shaders named in the release.
CoreFX is recommended by the author. Place the .ini in the ReShade presets folder and select it in the overlay.
items.previewCaption: Before and after comparison by PrimeGraphics.

items.name: UniT ClearVibe Preset
items.description: Free ClearVibe ReShade preset tuned for the QuantV version of FiveM.
items.author: UniT Presets
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy, QuantV and ReShade.
Choose the ClearVibe preset under Free presets and follow the author's instructions for loading it in ReShade.
items.previewCaption: Original gameplay screenshot from UniT’s ClearVibe preset gallery.

items.name: California Roads
items.description: California-style road textures for Los Santos, including revised asphalt and lane markings.
items.author: SLmodding
items.credits: SLmodding. Leoncoder credited for the original FiveM port.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM · Choose the 0.6 April FiveM build
requirements: Select 0.6 April FiveM in All Versions on the author’s release page.
Follow the FiveM build’s instructions and check it against the target game and server build.
items.previewCaption: Original screenshot from SLmodding’s California Roads April release.

items.name: Oulsen Satellite Map
items.description: A server-streamed satellite minimap with custom postals, street labels and an optional no-grid version.
items.author: Oulsen
items.license: MIT for the source repository. The README credits the base map and streaming code separately.
requirements: FiveM server with permission to install resources.
Keep the oulsen_satmap resource intact. Follow the README to enable it and choose the grid or no-grid textures.
items.previewCaption: Original map screenshot from Oulsen’s Cfx.re release post.

items.name: VisualVanilla
items.description: A standalone visual overhaul with revised weather, lighting, bloom and color. This is the final feature release.
items.author: Stryfaar
items.credits: Stryfaar. Built on VisualV by _CP_ and robi29.
requirements: Under All Versions, choose 2.0 for FiveM (FINAL). The main download is the single-player version.
The author puts the FiveM RPF files in FiveM.app/mods. Record which files you add and back up any files you replace before testing.

items.name: U1D GFX Core
items.description: A graphics overhaul with distinct weather palettes and revised lighting for dawn and dusk. It runs without ReShade or ENB.
items.author: U1D GFX
requirements: Select FiveM 1.0.0 in All Versions and use the written installation instructions included with that package.
Compare it on its own before layering another graphics preset over it.

items.name: X-Visual
items.description: A server resource that offers a menu for changing timecycle presets and vehicle light intensity in game.
items.author: Project-X
items.requirementLabel: Server resource · OneSync Infinity · MenuV or ox_lib
requirements: The author lists OneSync Infinity and either MenuV or ox_lib. Install the chosen menu library before starting X-Visual.
Use the configuration supplied by the author and check how its presets interact with your other visuals resources.

items.name: Serverside VisualSettings
items.description: A server utility for distributing a custom visualsettings.dat to connected players. Use it to tune shared effects such as vehicle lights.
items.author: Jarrrk
requirements: Name the folder VisualSettings and start it from server.cfg as the author describes.
Test a single visualsettings.dat on a test server before enabling it alongside other lighting resources.

items.name: FiveM Basic Server (Legacy)
items.description: Start a clean Legacy server with the default resources and configuration. A good starting point for testing individual resources.
items.author: Cfx.re / txAdmin
requirements: Use the recommended FiveM Legacy server build and a Cfx.re server key.
Choose FiveM Basic Server (Legacy) in Popular Recipes.

items.name: FiveM Basic Server (Enhanced)
items.description: Set up a minimal server for GTA V Enhanced, with a basic game mode, spawn handling and sample maps.
items.author: Cfx.re / txAdmin
requirements: Use the Enhanced server build and a Cfx.re server key. On Windows, install the Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable linked by Cfx.re.
Choose FiveM Basic Server (Enhanced) in Popular Recipes.

items.name: Qbox Framework
items.description: Qbox’s full roleplay starter. It includes jobs, vehicles and inventory along with the framework’s other active resources.
items.author: Qbox Project contributors
requirements: Install a current FXServer build and MariaDB 10.9 or newer. Qbox does not support MySQL or XAMPP.
Choose Qbox Framework in Popular Recipes and provide your database connection and Cfx.re server key.

items.name: Qbox Lean
items.description: A smaller Qbox base for building your own server. The recipe leaves out the bundled civilian and criminal activities.
items.author: Qbox Project contributors
requirements: Use the same FXServer and MariaDB requirements as Qbox Framework.
Open the recipe page, copy the Raw URL and paste it into txAdmin’s Remote URL Template.

items.name: ESX Legacy
items.description: The official ESX roleplay starter, with character registration, jobs, society accounts and vehicle shops.
items.author: ESX Framework
requirements: Have a current FXServer build, a Cfx.re server key and a running MariaDB instance before you deploy.
Choose ESX Legacy in Popular Recipes. The recipe installs oxmysql and loads the initial SQL.

items.name: QBCore Framework (legacy listing)
items.description: The original QBCore roleplay recipe includes jobs, gangs, housing and vehicles. txAdmin no longer recommends it in Popular Recipes.
items.author: JericoFx, Kakarot and Hamy
requirements: Set up FXServer, a Cfx.re server key and MariaDB as described in the QBCore guide.
The QBCore guide still shows an older Popular Recipes menu. Copy the Raw URL from the recipe page and use Remote URL Template instead.

items.name: MenuV
items.description: Standalone menu library with a browser-based interface. Use it to build menus in your own Lua resources.
items.author: ThymonA
requirements: Use the prebuilt archive from the release page. Keep the resource folder named menuv and start it before the resources that use it.

items.name: Ox Lib Context Menu
items.description: Build nested menus with icons, descriptive options and callbacks using the context menu module in Ox Lib.
items.author: Overextended
requirements: Install and start ox_lib before the resource that imports it. The context menu ships with the library.

items.name: qb-menu
items.description: The menu resource for QBCore scripts, with headings, buttons and per-option icons.
items.author: QBCore
requirements: Check whether your QBCore recipe already installed qb-menu. Start it before any resource that opens its menus.

items.name: Feji’s Realistic Sound Pack
items.description: Local weapon audio replacements for players who want a different sound mix on their own client.
items.author: Feji
requirements: Follow the author’s written instructions for the GTA V installation you use with FiveM. The release calls for replacing two archives in x64/audio/sfx.
Back up both originals and check that the server allows client audio replacements. The release does not establish Enhanced compatibility.

items.name: Weapon Sound Pack
items.description: Weapon audio that plays locally for the player who installs it.
items.author: hercet
requirements: Use the author’s FiveM release and identify the original archives in your GTA V x64/audio/sfx folder before changing files.
Check the server’s rules for client audio and keep the original files so you can restore them.

items.name: Custom Vehicle Engine Sounds
items.description: A set of engine and exhaust sounds that server operators can assign to individual vehicles.
items.author: Aquaphobic
items.requirementLabel: Server resource · Choose the FiveM build
requirements: Under All Versions, select 1.7 FiveM Server Resource. The main download is the single-player version.
Start the audio resource and set audioNameHash in each target vehicle’s vehicles.meta to a sound ID from the release.

items.name: Mazda RX-7 13B Rotary Engine Sound
items.description: A rotary engine and exhaust sound for an individual vehicle.
items.author: Aquaphobic
items.credits: Aquaphobic, with samples and REV guidance credited to Legacy_DMC in the release.
items.requirementLabel: Server resource · Los Santos Tuners assets
requirements: Use a FiveM server build with Los Santos Tuners assets and follow the FiveM instructions in the release’s readme.txt.
Set the target vehicle’s audioNameHash to rotary7.

items.name: Server-Sided Sounds and Sirens
items.description: Stream siren sound banks to players and assign the tones through a compatible emergency vehicle resource.
items.author: fk-1997
requirements: Install the server resource and keep its manifest and audio banks together.
Configure a compatible controller such as Luxart Vehicle Control V3 with the sound-bank and tone IDs from the repository.

items.name: Legion Square +
items.description: A standalone YMAP redesign of Legion Square with new landscaping and props.
items.author: zinpod (0breezy0)
requirements: Put the breezy_legionplus folder under the server’s resources directory and add ensure breezy_legionplus to server.cfg.
Test it with other Legion Square maps disabled first so you can spot overlapping props or collision.
items.previewCaption: Screenshot from the creator’s Legion Square + release.

items.name: Coin’s Sandy Shores Project
items.description: A Sandy Shores YMAP with new props, memorials and changes to roadside scenery.
items.author: Coin6969
requirements: Install the CoinsSandyProject folder that contains fxmanifest.lua and start that resource from server.cfg.
The author built this on the earlier CoinsTrees map. Compare it on its own before combining it with other Sandy Shores edits.

items.name: Omozan
items.description: A custom map from AndreIakko’s free MLO collection. The repository also contains vehicle and outfit resources in separate folders.
items.author: AndreIakko
requirements: For the map, install iak_omozan_map with its manifest and stream directory together. Start the resource on a test server.
Review the vehicle and outfit folders separately if you want to use those parts of the release.

items.name: bob74_ipl
items.description: A map utility for loading and customizing existing GTA V interiors and fixing missing map elements.
items.author: Bob74 and contributors
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Check for an existing copy
requirements: Check whether your framework already includes bob74_ipl. Use the release archive named bob74_ipl.zip and start the resource from server.cfg.
Use the upstream changelog to confirm your build and edition. The project documents separate streaming assets for Enhanced.

items.name: ONX Declasse Granger Revamp + Alamo
items.description: Two civilian SUVs based on the Granger platform. The Alamo is the shorter variant.
items.author: ONX, L’Kid and Tidemo
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Free ONX store package
requirements: Claim the free package on the ONX store. Follow the creator’s instructions for putting the vehicle resources under [onx_vehicles] and starting that group in server.cfg.
Test the vehicles through your server’s vehicle spawner. The standalone download does not include the separate ONX traffic pack.
items.previewCaption: Granger 3600LX screenshot from the ONX release.

items.name: Grodd Customs Vehicle Pack
items.description: Seventeen civilian add-ons, including modified sedans, wagons, muscle cars and SUVs. The release lists the tuning options and spawn names for each.
items.author: Grodd Customs
requirements: Use the FiveM resource folder and add ensure groddcustoms to server.cfg.
Use the release’s model names when configuring your spawner or dealership. For a first test, the author lists senhart and oracle_gts.

items.name: Driving School Blista
items.description: A Blista with a driving school livery for lessons and roleplay events.
items.author: Nukepug Designs
requirements: Install the npdsblista folder from the repository and add ensure npdsblista to server.cfg.
Use npdsblista as the model name in your authorized vehicle spawner or driving school resource.

items.name: Maibatsu Sunrise R Hycade
items.description: A custom Sunrise R with a Hycade body kit and a separate FiveM resource in the release.
items.author: SNStudios
items.credits: SNStudios for the Hycade body kit. The release credits Boywond for the original model.
requirements: Use the hycsunrise resource from the archive’s FiveM folder. Start hycsunrise in server.cfg.
Use hycsun as the model name in your spawner. The resource and model names are different.

items.name: Graffiti Hoodies Pack
items.description: Male and female freemode hoodies in hood-up and hood-down versions, each with eight graffiti textures.
items.author: FlaaDev
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Male and female freemode
requirements: Install the flaadev-8graffitih folder and add ensure flaadev-8graffitih to server.cfg.
Check both freemode models in your server’s appearance menu after the resource starts.

items.name: Judge Robe
items.description: Courtroom robes for male and female freemode characters.
items.author: jimgordon20
items.credits: jimgordon20 adapted and released the set. Buckeye923 made the original male robe and grzybeek contributed fixes.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Male and female freemode
requirements: Use the current Judge_Robe_fivem_f_and_m resource folder from the repository. Start it from server.cfg.
Check the add-on entries in your appearance menu on both freemode models. The author documents fixes in the current release.
items.previewCaption: Screenshot from the creator’s Judge Robe release.

items.name: Simple Summer Dress
items.description: An original female freemode dress with moving fabric and multiple textures.
items.author: Popcorn Roleplay
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Female freemode · Free Tebex checkout
requirements: Claim the free item through the creator’s store. The creator ties use to the purchaser’s FiveM server license.
Install the supplied resource according to the creator’s instructions and test the dress while walking and sitting.
items.previewCaption: Product image from Popcorn Roleplay’s dress release.

items.name: Felis Missing Clothing Textures
items.description: Replacement textures for existing male and female clothing and props that show a checkerboard pattern.
items.author: Felis Development
requirements: Start fd_missing_textures before the clothing group, as shown in the README. The separate ydd and images folders are optional reference files.
Test the original clothing slots again after starting the resource. This pack replaces textures in those slots.
items.previewCaption: Texture examples from Felis Development’s release.

items.name: Cluckin’ Bell Prop Pack
items.description: Nineteen food, drink and packaging props for Cluckin’ Bell scenes.
items.author: Nukepug Designs
requirements: Install the npds_clukinbell_proppack folder and add ensure npds_clukinbell_proppack to server.cfg.
For inventory items, follow the README’s ox_inventory setup. The author tested that integration with ox_inventory and limits use to noncommercial purposes.

items.name: Coffee Prop Pack
items.description: Ten coffee-themed props for cafés, kitchens and interiors.
items.author: The Texture
requirements: Claim the free package through the creator’s store and start the supplied resource on your server.
Use a compatible housing or object placement script to place the props in game.

items.name: BzZzi Garden Props
items.description: Five types of garden plants with three variants each, including hops, barley and cornstalks.
items.author: BzZzi
requirements: Use the archive attached to the creator’s release and start the resource in server.cfg.
If you integrate the models into another resource, preserve the YTYP and its matching DLC_ITYP_REQUEST declaration as described in the release.

items.name: Modular Timber Deck
items.description: Six deck components for map builders, with optional handrails and an example beach placement.
items.author: LamontCranston
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Props and example YMAP
requirements: Start the example map as its own resource or keep the props and included YTYP together in your map project’s stream folder.
The author allows noncommercial use. Check the creator’s terms before including the deck in another resource.

items.name: RPEmotes Reborn
items.description: A standalone emote menu with built-in animations, shared emotes, props and support for custom animation lists.
items.author: alberttheprince and contributors
requirements: Extract the release into a resource named rpemotes-reborn and add ensure rpemotes-reborn to server.cfg.
The maintainers require OneSync Infinity for synchronization and recommend the latest supported game build. Use oxmysql if you enable SQL features.

items.name: Hands in Pockets
items.description: A custom idle animation for roleplay scenes. The release supplies the dictionary and clip names.
items.author: BzZzi
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · YCD animation · Emote integration
requirements: Use the archive attached to the author’s post and put the YCD in a resource’s stream folder.
Register dictionary bzzz@animations@hands and clip bz_hands in your emote resource. The author gives a DPEmotes example.

items.name: L&L Pose Animation Pack
items.description: Five custom pose animations for screenshots and staged scenes.
items.author: L&L Shop
requirements: Choose the free option on the creator’s store or use the attachment on the original release post.
Follow the included README and use the supplied animation list entries if your server runs DPEmotes.

items.name: Custom SP & MP Poses
items.description: A set of static character poses for arranging scenes in single-player or on a FiveM server.
items.author: crunchycat
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · FiveM instructions in README
requirements: Follow the FiveM instructions in the included README.
Use the pack’s dictionary and clip names with your server’s animation resource and test the poses on the intended ped model.

items.name: Popcorn RP Pets
items.description: A free collection of animal models including a Chow Chow, a Dobermann, K9 dogs, an armadillo and a robot dog.
items.author: Popcorn RP and credited contributors
requirements: Keep fxmanifest.lua, data and stream together in a resource folder named popcornrp-pets and add ensure popcornrp-pets to server.cfg.
Read the model name from the matching peds.meta entry. Pet interactions require a separate compatible resource such as keep-companion-ox.
items.previewCaption: Popcorn RP’s preview of its FiveM animal models.

items.name: Pablo ‘Fat Cop’ Taco
items.description: A free human character model with casual outfits and police uniform variants for LSPD, BCSO and SAHP.
items.author: TehHitman
requirements: Open cfx-pablo-hitman.zip on the author’s repository and use the enclosed FiveM resource folder.
Start the resource by its folder name. Use the supplied model name in your server’s ped selector and test the outfit variants.
items.previewCaption: TehHitman’s preview of the Pablo Taco character model.

items.name: Anubis
items.description: A fantasy character model with multiple eye and body variants and levels of detail for different viewing distances.
items.author: SSERAFIM MODS
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Paid Tebex release · Asset Escrow
requirements: Place the supplied sera_anubis folder in your server’s resources folder and add ensure sera_anubis to server.cfg.
Use sera_anubis as the model name in your server’s ped selector.
